criteria.reason: Presents both colleagues' views in parallel without endorsing either; neutral conditional framing throughout.
Never states the two-thirds domestic / one-third abroad rule; no accurate content on the split.
Fairly explains the displacement/outsourcing critique (moral licensing, paying others) and its conditions.
Gives clear criteria (additionality, verifiability, supplement-not-substitute) for the user to judge.

summary: Neutral and fair on both arguments with clear judging criteria, but omits the two-thirds domestic reduction rule.
